types.name: Distance, midpoint and section
types.description: Asks for the distance between two points, a midpoint, the point dividing a segment in a ratio (or the ratio itself), a centroid, or a missing vertex of a parallelogram.

types.name: Slope and equation of a line
types.description: Asks for the slope of a line, the equation of a line through given points or with a given slope, a line parallel or perpendicular to another, where two lines meet, or the distance of a point from a line.

types.name: Intercepts and axes
types.description: Asks where a line cuts the x-axis or y-axis, its intercepts, or the area or perimeter of the triangle a line makes with the two axes.

types.name: Area and collinearity
types.description: Asks for the area of a triangle or quadrilateral from the coordinates of its corners, or whether three points lie on one line (collinear), often with an unknown k.

types.name: Quadrants and reflections
types.description: Asks which quadrant a point lies in, its distance from an axis, or its mirror image in an axis, the origin, or a line such as y = x.
